nodes.label: Lightweight Process (no Spec Kit cycle)
nodes.rationale: Full Spec Kit cycle took most of a day for DDPM; handoff is the spec.

nodes.label: BCE + Soft Dice Loss Formulation
nodes.rationale: BCE gives smooth gradients and calibrated probabilities so tau=0.5 is meaningful; Dice counters ~14% foreground imbalance and matches IoU/Dice metrics; smoothing s=1 handles empty masks; pos_weight available but unused.

nodes.label: Binary Semantic Segmentation Task
nodes.rationale: Assignment asks to segment clothes for virtual try-on; a single clothes mask and RGBA cut-out answer it directly and make BCE+Dice and IoU/Dice natural. Per-garment classes add softmax head, imbalance handling and per-class metrics without serving the goal.

nodes.label: Pretrained ResNet-34 Encoder
nodes.rationale: ImageNet features separate textures/fabrics/skin; val IoU 0.825 after one epoch removed risk of unstated performance bar; ResNet-50's 2048-channel bottleneck would exceed 3 GB budget at batch 16.

nodes.label: ResNet34UNet Topology
nodes.rationale: U-Net gives context at 8x8 plus pixel-exact boundaries through skips; 24,436,241 params (21.28M encoder + 3.15M decoder/head).

nodes.label: StandardUNet (from-scratch baseline)
nodes.rationale: Classic Ronneberger U-Net with ConvTranspose2d, 7,763,041 params; baseline for pretraining vs scratch comparison, not fully trained.

nodes.label: BatchNorm, No Attention
nodes.rationale: Batch 16 gives stable BN stats matching pretrained encoder (DDPM needed GroupNorm due to micro-batching); garments are large contiguous regions so attention would waste 4 GB GPU memory.

nodes.label: Bilinear Upsampling + Convolution
nodes.rationale: Transposed convs with stride 2 cause checkerboard artefacts along garment edges; bilinear (align_corners=True) + two 3x3 convs gives smooth masks; size guard handles odd inputs.

nodes.label: Decoder Channel Widths [256,128,64,32,16]
nodes.rationale: Halve channels as resolution doubles; two extra stages recover full resolution because ResNet stem downsamples by 4.

nodes.label: 256x256 Resize + ImageNet Normalization
nodes.rationale: 256x256 fits batch 16 fp32 in 3 GB; masks nearest-neighbour resized to stay binary; ImageNet stats match pretrained encoder.

nodes.label: D2: Pretrained encoder instead of from-scratch
nodes.norm_label: d2: pretrained encoder instead of from-scratch
nodes.rationale: CVCY002 has no from-scratch requirement; val IoU 0.825 after one epoch; standard_unet remains registered.

nodes.label: D3: BatchNorm, no EMA, select by val IoU
nodes.norm_label: d3: batchnorm, no ema, select by val iou
nodes.rationale: Batch 16 stable BN stats; EMA matters for diffusion sampling not 15-epoch fine-tune; selecting on IoU optimizes the reported metric.

nodes.label: User Decisions (simple U-Net, BCE+Dice, IoU/Dice)
nodes.rationale: One-day project: keep it simple and fast; regular U-Net without attention because clothes are large regions and the GPU has 4 GB; same layout as VAE/DDPM.

nodes.label: Easy cases: full-body, plain background, solid dresses/garments
nodes.norm_label: easy cases: full-body, plain background, solid dresses/garments
nodes.rationale: Best cases are frontal standing full-body shots with large contiguous garments (dresses, blazer+shorts) against uncluttered walls/backgrounds; belts included as clothes, bags/shoes/hats excluded per Clothes Label Rule.
